profiles.notes: AY2027/28 undergraduate qualification routes. Each policy names the applicable credential.

requirements.label: AP · American High School Diploma route
requirements.details: Present strong diploma results and five College Board AP exam scores of 4 or 5. Singapore citizens and permanent residents can also apply with at least three AP tests. Scores must reach NTU by 15 July 2027. Use the programme prerequisites and qualification page to check eligibility.

source.title: NTU 2027 American high school diploma and AP criteria

requirements.label: AP · Calculus BC and Physics C
requirements.details: The dedicated admissions page specifies AP Calculus BC for Applied Computing in Finance, Economics and Data Science, Engineering and most Science programmes. AP Physics C applies when Physics is a minimum subject requirement. The international matrix also mentions Mathematics Level 2 in the American Diploma row. Confirm acceptable evidence with NTU where the two sources differ.

source.title: NTU 2027 American high school diploma and AP criteria

requirements.label: AP · supplement for other listed international qualification routes
requirements.details: For secondary qualifications marked as requiring a supplementary qualification in the international guide, one listed route is at least three AP tests with scores of 4 or 5. Choose subjects that match the proposed programme. AP Calculus BC applies to Engineering and most Science programmes under this route.

source.title: NTU 2027 international qualifications, PDF pp. 9–10

requirements.label: UK GCE A-level / IAL · direct qualification route
requirements.details: Present good passes in at least four A-level subjects from the same examination period. Recognised examination boards can be combined within that sitting. Decisions depend on the applicant pool and programme.

source.title: NTU UK GCE A-level and International A-level eligibility

requirements.label: UK GCE A-level / IAL · three-subject exceptions
requirements.details: Singapore citizens and permanent residents with three good passes in the same sitting may apply. International applicants with three good passes and outstanding achievements, such as international Science Olympiad medals, may be considered individually. The matrix also mentions consideration for three good passes at non-subsidised fees. Confirm the fee and applicant conditions for your route.

source.title: NTU UK GCE A-level and International A-level eligibility

requirements.label: UK GCE A-level / IAL · August 2027 results
requirements.details: Applicants whose actual A2 results come out in August 2027 should apply for the 2028 admissions cycle.

source.title: NTU 2027 international qualifications, PDF pp. 9–10

requirements.label: UK GCE A-level · supplement to another school qualification
requirements.details: For routes explicitly marked as needing an additional qualification, the international guide lists a UK A-level option of at least three subjects completed within 12 months in up to two sittings. Actual A-level or A2 results must be available before June. Engineering and most Science programmes require A-level Mathematics or Further Mathematics.

source.title: NTU 2027 international qualifications, PDF pp. 9–10

requirements.label: IB · direct transcript access and exam timing
requirements.details: Grant NTU direct access to IBO results. For November 2026 and earlier sessions the access deadline is 19 March 2027. May 2027 candidates grant access by the end of June and submit final results within three days of release where eligible. The May 2027 exception list includes Medicine and both Academic Discipline and Education degrees.

source.title: NTU general admissions, IB Diploma section
